subject: Remittance mismatch — Sterling Tech payment applied to wrong invoice
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@sterling-tech.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: billing@sterling-tech.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Payment remittance — please advise

Hi Marissa,

We sent a wire on 2026-10-30 for $48,510.00 referencing our PO# ST-4492. Our bank remittance shows the funds were credited to invoice 2026-03-01 (INV-20260301) on your side, but that invoice was already paid in June. Can you confirm which invoice the payment was applied to and, if applied in error, how you intend to credit or reapply the payment?

I've attached the remittance advice (SterlingRemittance.pdf) and a screenshot from our bank showing the trace number. We need this resolved before we close the month on our side — internal AP is asking for a confirmation by 11/05.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Senior AP Analyst
Sterling Tech, Inc.
attachments: SterlingRemittance.pdf, Sterling_Payment_Evidence.png
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@sterling-tech.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment remittance — please advise

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the docs. We see the $48,510 receipt in our bank feed with the trace you provided, but it was mistakenly matched to INV-20260301 (June invoice) by our automated lockbox matcher.

Action plan:
- I'm looping in David (AR) and Marcus (Accounting) to confirm the correct invoice(s) and prepare a credit or reapplication JE.
- We will aim to provide a formal confirmation to Sterling AP by 2026-11-05.

David/Marcus — can you take the lead on verifying which open invoices should get the cash (likely INV-20261029-ST and INV-20261101-ST) and draft the posting lines? I've attached an initial JE draft for review.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: AR_Adjustment_JE_DRAFT.xlsx
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Payment remittance — please advise

Forwarding Sterling's remittance and Marissa's notes. I pulled the AR ledger and see: 
- INV-20260301: Paid 2026-06-15 (cleared)
- INV-20261029-ST: Open, $27,000
- INV-20261101-ST: Open, $21,510

Proposed accounting fix (journal to reapply cash):
  Dr. Cash $48,510
  Cr. Accounts Receivable INV-20260301 $48,510 (reverse incorrect application)
  Dr. Accounts Receivable INV-20261029-ST $27,000
  Dr. Accounts Receivable INV-20261101-ST $21,510
  Cr. Cash $48,510 (re-apply)

This is effectively two entries to clear the misapplication and reassign the receipt to the correct invoices. Marcus — can you review and confirm the JE description meets audit requirements (include remittance trace and HUBS id)? Monica — tagging you for tax impact review: moving cash between AR records could affect month-end revenue recognition mapping if collections touch invoices in different periods. 

David
Senior AR Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: david.kim@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Payment remittance — please advise

Thanks, David — I reviewed the draft JE and the bank trace. A couple of notes for SOX/audit completeness: 
- JE narrative should reference Bank trace: TRX-779234 and Sterling PO ST-4492.
- Move the reversal of INV-20260301 to the 'Clearing - Misapplied Receipts' subledger so we have an audit trail of the correction.
- Add a supporting schedule (I updated AR_Adjustment_JE_DRAFT.xlsx with lines for subledger posting and GL account numbers).

On tax/revenue recognition: Monica, your point is valid. If INV-20260301 was recognized in FY26-Q2 and the newly applied invoices are FY26-Q4, the cash timing won't change revenue already recognized, but we should record the correction as an AR allocation—no revenue reversal required. Please confirm.

If no objections, I'll post the reversal on 2026-11-06 and the reapplication on 2026-11-07 so Sterling gets confirmation before their month close.

Marcus Lin
Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com, david.kim@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: lisa.chen@sterling-tech.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Re: Payment remittance — please advise

All — confirmed and posting completed. Summary for Sterling: 
- We reversed the misapplied payment from INV-20260301 on 2026-11-06 (Clearing - Misapplied Receipts).
- We reapplied the cash to INV-20261029-ST ($27,000) and INV-20261101-ST ($21,510) on 2026-11-07.
- No revenue reversal required; this is an AR allocation correction.

Lisa (cc'd): please see the attached confirmation PDF showing the reapplication lines and the bank trace (SterlingRemittance.pdf). Let us know if you need a remittance confirmation letter for your records.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Financial Reporting & Tax
Redwood Inference
attachments: SterlingRemittance.pdf
